name: ARCAS Short, FINS OFF (NASA TN D-4013 half-scale tunnel model, body only)
_notes: FINS-OFF VARIANT of arcas-short.json, added 2026-08-25. Byte-identical to that fixture with the trapezoidfinset child DELETED and nothing else changed - same nose, same tube length, same 15-deg boat tail, same finishpolished finish, same machAlt Re-matching (supplied by anchors.json). Read that fixture's _notes for the geometry derivation and the 2026-08-25 re-fixture rulings; they all apply here unchanged.

WHY IT EXISTS: TN D-4013 wind-tunnel-tested the ARCAS with No Fins (Body Only) as well as with fins, and that fins-off curve is the only measurement in the whole anchor set that isolates our BODY drag from our FIN drag. Gated as the cd0-finsoff-tunnel series in anchors.json. Until 2026-08-25 only the fins-on TOTAL was gated, which let a body error and a fin error of opposite sign cancel inside one passing row.

THE TUNNEL MODEL STILL HAS ITS BOAT TAIL. 'Fins off' in D-4013 means the fins were removed from the same model, not that a different, boat-tail-free body was tested. This is therefore NOT the 'plain body (finless, no boat-tail)' cell validation/README.md lists as absent; that one is still absent.

FIN-ROOT ANCHORS - RESOLVED 2026-08-25 FROM THE REPORT, AND THE ANSWER IS 'THEY STAYED ON, UN-FAIRED'. NASA TN D-4013 p.3: 'The fin anchors (fig. 1(b)) were used to plug the slots in the boattailed afterbody when the SHORT model was investigated without fins, whereas the slots were plugged with balsa and faired flush with the model skin when the LONG model was investigated without fins.' So on THIS configuration four un-faired fin anchors (arcas-short.json's notes: 0.178 in^2 total frontal) are present in the tunnel number and are not modelled here, and our fins-off model therefore reads LOW by their contribution (~+0.010 CD on this geometry at the 0.22 'streamlined with base' class) - which makes our measured fins-off EXCESS larger still, not smaller. The report itself charges them with the short model's C_A,corr rising ABOVE the long model's at M0.975-1.20 (p.6). arcas-long-finsoff carries no such bias; where the two cells disagree, prefer the long one.

CONSISTENCY REQUIREMENT (checked 2026-08-25, holds to 1e-16): fins-on total CD minus this fixture's total CD must equal the fins-on sweep's per-component fin-set row exactly, at every Mach and in both models. Removing the fin set changes nothing else in the kernel - body wetted area is not reduced under the fin root, and base area is unchanged (base CD identical to 6 decimals). If that identity ever stops holding, this fixture pair has drifted and neither number can be trusted.

BOUNDARY LAYER: TRIPPED, settled 2026-08-25 from the report (p.4) - 'a 0.25-cm-wide (0.10-in.) strip of No. 120 carborundum grains was affixed around the model 3.17 cm (1.25 in.) aft of the nose and 1.27 cm (0.5 in.) aft of the leading edge of each fin'. The fixture's finishpolished surface and the kernel's fully-turbulent friction are therefore the right modelling choice for this cell, and the fully-turbulent-only defect (docs/research/trf-aero-research-2026-08-25.md section 6) CANNOT be invoked to explain this cell's excess. Test conditions: Re 9.8e6 per metre (3.0e6 per foot) held constant across the Mach range, stagnation temperature 322 K, 1/2-scale model, 1-in sting.

GEOMETRY CONFLICT WORTH A LOOK, NOT ACTED ON HERE: TN D-4013 figure 1(b) dimensions the tail cone in body diameters and gives its base as 0.65 d, i.e. 1.463 in at the full-scale 2.250-in body, where this fixture uses 1.308 in (derived last session from Detail A's dimensioned cone-base radius 0.654). If 0.65 d is the right base, our base AREA is 0.80x the tunnel's and our base CD is low by the same factor. Changing it would move every ARCAS row, so it is recorded and left alone; it does not touch this cell's gates, which are base-EXCLUDED.

ANCHOR SOURCE UPGRADED 2026-08-25: the gated series for this fixture is no longer a quoted single-point figure read but the whole measured curve, digitized from NASA TN D-4013's own NTRS page scan at native resolution and gated only at the Mach numbers the report actually tested. See anchors.json _provenance and scorecard-finsoff-figs-2026-08-25.md.
